qrcodeData =
    from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(
            start: v.timeRangeStart,
            stop: v.timeRangeStop
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["_measurement"] == "${meas}" and
            r["_field"] == "qrcode"
        )
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            r with
            slot_key:
                string(v: r.storehouse_id) + "|" +
                string(v: r.pallet_position) + "|" +
                string(v: r.position_id)
        }))
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r.slot_key =~ /^${slot_filter:regex}$/
        )

        // Get latest QRCode for each physical slot
        |> group(columns: [
            "storehouse_id",
            "pallet_position",
            "position_id"
        ])
        |> sort(
            columns: ["_time"],
            desc: true
        )
        |> limit(n: 1)

        // Keep QRCode timestamp for final deduplication
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            qr_time: r._time,
            qrcode: string(v: r._value),
            storehouse_id: r.storehouse_id,
            pallet_position: r.pallet_position,
            position_id: r.position_id
        }))
        |> group()


errorData =
    from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(
            start: v.timeRangeStart,
            stop: v.timeRangeStop
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["_measurement"] == "${meas}" and
            r["_field"] == "error_value"
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["return_code"] =~ /^${return_code:regex}$/
        )
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            r with
            slot_key:
                string(v: r.storehouse_id) + "|" +
                string(v: r.pallet_position) + "|" +
                string(v: r.position_id)
        }))
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r.slot_key =~ /^${slot_filter:regex}$/
        )

        // Get latest error value for each physical slot
        |> group(columns: [
            "storehouse_id",
            "pallet_position",
            "position_id"
        ])
        |> sort(
            columns: ["_time"],
            desc: true
        )
        |> limit(n: 1)

        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            error_value: r._value,
            storehouse_id: r.storehouse_id,
            pallet_position: r.pallet_position,
            position_id: r.position_id
        }))
        |> group()


codeData =
    from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(
            start: v.timeRangeStart,
            stop: v.timeRangeStop
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["_measurement"] == "${meas}" and
            r["_field"] == "error_code"
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r["return_code"] =~ /^${return_code:regex}$/
        )
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            r with
            slot_key:
                string(v: r.storehouse_id) + "|" +
                string(v: r.pallet_position) + "|" +
                string(v: r.position_id)
        }))
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r.slot_key =~ /^${slot_filter:regex}$/
        )

        // Get latest error code for each physical slot
        |> group(columns: [
            "storehouse_id",
            "pallet_position",
            "position_id"
        ])
        |> sort(
            columns: ["_time"],
            desc: true
        )
        |> limit(n: 1)

        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            error_code: string(v: r._value),
            storehouse_id: r.storehouse_id,
            pallet_position: r.pallet_position,
            position_id: r.position_id
        }))
        |> group()


// Join error value and error code
errorWithCode =
    join(
        tables: {
            err: errorData,
            code: codeData
        },
        on: [
            "storehouse_id",
            "pallet_position",
            "position_id"
        ],
        method: "inner"
    )


// Join QRCode
result =
    join(
        tables: {
            data: errorWithCode,
            qr: qrcodeData
        },
        on: [
            "storehouse_id",
            "pallet_position",
            "position_id"
        ],
        method: "inner"
    )

        // Format error value
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            _time: r.qr_time,
            qrcode: r.qrcode,

            _value:
                if
                    r.error_code == "OV" or
                    r.error_code == "UV" or
                    r.error_code == "OVS" or
                    r.error_code == "OWVS" or
                    r.error_code == "OWVP"
                then
                    string(v: r.error_value) + " mV"

                else if
                    r.error_code == "OT" or
                    r.error_code == "OTS" or
                    r.error_code == "OTW" or
                    r.error_code == "OTF"
                then
                    string(v: float(v: r.error_value) / 10.0) + " Â°C"

                else if
                    r.error_code == "OC" or
                    r.error_code == "UC"
                then
                    string(v: r.error_value) + " mA"

                else if
                    r.error_code == "CTO"
                then
                    string(v: float(v: r.error_value) / 60000.0) + " Mins"

                else
                    string(v: r.error_value)
        }))


// Each QRCode keeps only its latest record
result
    |> group(columns: ["qrcode"])

    // Latest QRCode record first
    |> sort(
        columns: ["_time"],
        desc: true
    )

    |> limit(n: 1)

    // Final Grafana output
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        qrcode: r.qrcode,
        _value: r._value
    }))

base =
    from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(
            start: v.timeRangeStart,

                r["_field"] == "protectboard_id"
            )
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>

        )

            r with

        )
        |> pivot(
            rowKey: [
                "_time",
                "storehouse_id",
                "pallet_position",
                "position_id",
                "return_code"
            ],
            columnKey: ["_field"],
            valueColumn: "_value"
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            exists r.qrcode and
            exists r.serialboard_id and
            exists r.protectboard_id
        )

voltage =
    base

WITH Latest AS
(
    SELECT
        m.SessionIndexID,
        m.QRCode,
        m.StartTime,
        m.SerialBoardID,
        m.ProtectBoardID,
        m.StoreHouseID,
        m.PalletPosition,
        m.PositionID,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY
                m.StoreHouseID,
                m.PalletPosition,
                m.PositionID
            ORDER BY
                m.StartTime DESC,
                m.SessionIndexID DESC
        ) AS rn

    FROM [BALPS].[dbo].[MeasSessionIndex] AS m

    WHERE
        m.StartTime >= DATEADD(HOUR, -4, $__timeFrom())
        AND m.StartTime <= DATEADD(HOUR, 0, $__timeTo())
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(m.QRCode AS nvarchar(100)) AS __text,
    CAST(m.QRCode AS nvarchar(100)) AS __value

FROM Latest AS m

WHERE

list.name: select_export_data
list.query: Voltage : voltage, Temperature : temperature, Current : current, WireVoltage : wire_voltage

list.definition:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT '${select_export_data:csv}' AS expr
),
split_expr AS (
  SELECT r.expr, LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)) AS value
  FROM raw r
  CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(r.expr, ',') AS s
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN MIN(LTRIM(RTRIM(expr))) IN ('All') THEN 'true'
    ELSE STRING_AGG('r["_field"] == "' + value + '"', ' or ')
  END AS result
FROM split_expr;

list.definition:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(
      start: v.timeRangeStart,
      stop: v.timeRangeStop
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["_measurement"] == "${meas}" and
      (
          r["_field"] == "serialboard_id" or
          r["_field"] == "protectboard_id"
      )
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["return_code"] =~ /^${return_code:regex}$/
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      slot_key:
          string(v: r.storehouse_id) + "|" +
          string(v: r.pallet_position) + "|" +
          string(v: r.position_id)
  }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r.slot_key =~ /^${slot_filter:regex}$/
  )
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: [
          "_time",
          "storehouse_id",
          "pallet_position",
          "position_id",
          "return_code"
      ],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      exists r.serialboard_id and
      exists r.protectboard_id
  )
  |> group(columns: [
      "storehouse_id",
      "pallet_position",
      "position_id"
  ])
  |> last(column: "serialboard_id")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _value:
          string(v: r.serialboard_id) +
          " | " +
          string(v: r.protectboard_id)
  }))

query.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(
      start: v.timeRangeStart,
      stop: v.timeRangeStop
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["_measurement"] == "${meas}" and
      (
          r["_field"] == "serialboard_id" or
          r["_field"] == "protectboard_id"
      )
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["return_code"] =~ /^${return_code:regex}$/
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      slot_key:
          string(v: r.storehouse_id) + "|" +
          string(v: r.pallet_position) + "|" +
          string(v: r.position_id)
  }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r.slot_key =~ /^${slot_filter:regex}$/
  )
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: [
          "_time",
          "storehouse_id",
          "pallet_position",
          "position_id",
          "return_code"
      ],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      exists r.serialboard_id and
      exists r.protectboard_id
  )
  |> group(columns: [
      "storehouse_id",
      "pallet_position",
      "position_id"
  ])
  |> last(column: "serialboard_id")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _value:
          string(v: r.serialboard_id) +
          " | " +
          string(v: r.protectboard_id)
  }))
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"])
  |> limit(n: 1)
